results: Production: no fictional places, no simulator, explicit integration-pending state
Admin route guard, login failure, login success and empty place list
Add, unique number validation, table linking, drag, single-step undo/redo, resize and rotate
Layout persists across page reload in the development store
Failed save retains draft; retry saves successfully
Concurrent-tab revision conflict never silently overwrites the saved layout
Expired admin session blocks editor; signing back in restores the unsaved draft
Device registration, seat assignment, one-time token disclosure and persisted settings
Simulated authenticated device updates, two viewers, disconnect masking and snapshot resynchronization
Favorites, accessible numbered seats, availability filtering and responsive user layouts
Resetting transient development readings preserves layout and returns every seat to unknown
Delete and Ctrl+Z shortcuts, Ctrl+S commits an active property field, read-only preview
Duplicate seat assignment is disabled; token rotation revokes old token; disabled device cannot send readings
Canvas shrink validation, place rename/slug edit, deletion impact confirmation, missing place state and logout
Actual browser visual QA at 1440, 768 and 390 for user, editor, devices and production login

findings.message: 1 pair(s) of cards in one row end at different heights (by 740px).
findings.fix: Cards that share a row share a bottom edge: balance them by their content (the same number of rows, a block of similar height beside it), or stack them. In testing, ragged rows were marked down every time.
